properties.description: BUILT 2026-10-25 under dec:a-fix-names-the-findings-it-answers-in-the-same-call (option a of fact:root-cause-a-fix-rarely-records-what-it-answered-because-it-is-a-separate-call-2026-10-25). add_change_event's `answers` lists findings (finding_id, optional finding_type, optional note for a partial answer); each must be an existing Verification or TemporalFact or the whole call is refused and nothing is written. An INVALIDATES edge is drawn from the change to each, carrying its note and the change's stored detected_at as `at`. `answers: []` stores `answered_none: true` on the ChangeEvent (schema/temporal.yaml); a later list naming a finding takes that back. loop_status counts `fixes_answering_nothing`: live defect_fix / test_failure_fix events with no INVALIDATES and no answered_none, leaving out events a checksum acceptance minted, and says it in ONE `next` line; never counted against `clean`, because every design written before `answers` holds such fixes (the mixed-vintage hazard). `invalidates` stays for answering after the fact. Code: crates/reflow2-mcp/src/tools/temporal_tools.rs (add_change_event), crates/reflow2-mcp/src/service.rs (AnswerReq), crates/reflow2-core/src/repair.rs (fixes_answering_nothing), crates/reflow2-core/src/report.rs (loop_status).
properties.name: add_change_event takes `answers` and draws INVALIDATES in the same call; a fix that answers nothing is one loop_status line until it names one or says none
